2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Sisai P.S. Case No.51 of 2025 for the alleged offences registered under Sections 64, 351(2) and 351(3) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 pending in the Court of learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Gumla.
3.
